description: This Java class 'EntityCrypto' provides cryptographic functionalities for encrypting and decrypting data, managing cryptographic keys, and handling different storage mechanisms for keys within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for key generation, encryption, decryption, and key retrieval, supporting multiple encryption strategies and backward compatibility.

classes.name: EntityCrypto
classes.description: Main class providing cryptographic operations for entity data within OFBiz, including key management, encryption, and decryption.

classes.name: EntityCrypto.StorageHandler
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for different storage mechanisms for cryptographic keys.

classes.name: EntityCrypto.ShiroStorageHandler
classes.description: Implementation of StorageHandler using Apache Shiro's cryptographic services with optional key encryption.

classes.name: EntityCrypto.LegacyStorageHandler
classes.description: Implementation of StorageHandler using DES encryption for backward compatibility.

classes.name: EntityCrypto.SaltedBase64StorageHandler
classes.description: Implementation of StorageHandler that uses salted Base64 encoding with optional key encryption.

methods.name: EntityCrypto
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EntityCrypto with a delegator and optional key encryption key.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts an object into a hex-encoded string using a specified key and encryption method.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a hex-encoded string into an object using a specified key and encryption method, with fallback for old algorithms.

methods.name: doDecrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption using a specific storage handler.

methods.name: findKey
methods.description: Retrieves the cryptographic key associated with a given key name, generating and storing it if necessary.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key and stores it in the EntityKeyStore.
